name: MTV Splitsvilla
description: Ready to witness the ultimate fight between the rules of science and the laws of love? 10 boys, 10 girls and an Oracle who will decide whether or not a couple makes the perfect match! It's time to 'catch your match', Splitsvilla style!

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The new season of Splitsvilla 13 started with a new format. Rannvijay Singh and Sunny Leone introduce two arrows (one gold and another silver) with two different meanings. They also unveil all the contestants to each other. Based on the first impression already some infatuation created among the participants.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Three boys (Kevin Almasifar, Nikhil Malik, Vyomesh Koul) of gold villa got an amazing opportunity go on date with the girls they got the golden arrow from. After the date boys had to choose one girl to come to the golden villa who will automatically become safe in the next dome session. Vyomesh Koul's choice started a lot of trouble among the contestants of the villa.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: The first official task of splitsville season thirteen was on the horizon. Two guys from the silver villa who received the most silver arrow got the chance to challenge the boys of the golden villa. They had to pair up with a girl to compete in the challenge. After the challenge comes the first-ever dome session where their also two sides of the oracle: the gold side and silverside.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: The first silver connection challenge is introduced where a musical chair type situation is created. In this special kind of musical chair, task boys had to act like a chair and girls had to get on them when the music stops. Every round the eliminated girl will challenge two boys for survival in the game. Surprisingly the round was won by Vyomesh Koul and Azuma Fallah. Later a commotion started in the villa because everyone wanted to switch connections.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: The winner of yesterday's challenge got a chance to challenge two other people. Task had to perform in trio and four teams selected their desired team consisting of one boy and two girls in each team. There were some fun activities to perform in the task. The task was won by the amazing performance by Kat Kristian's team.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: In this episode winners of the last task get to choose a person to go before the oracle with. As Rannvijay explained two girls are going home the voting became interesting. Eventually, after a few dramas and twists, Azuma Fallah and Shweta Nair got dumped. On the next day, Nikhil Chinappa brought two new contestants to join in the competition.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Nikhil Chinappa officially introduced the two new wild villa contest winners to join the splitsville and secretly gave them tasks to perform with other contestants. Sapna Malik won the secret task challenge and got a chance to steal a place in the gold villa.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Kat Kristian and Kevin Almasifar start a new day after officially became the ideal match. And in the next sliver connection challenge girls from the silver villa had to paint the boys. In the task, Aditi Rajput and Nikita Bhamidipati performed well and won the task.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: New days starts with a new task. This task opened a lot of different cans of worms. Girls had to choose from different interesting and somewhat demeaning apps to tag each other with. And boys had to validate those apps by giving stars under those apps. Bhoomika Vashisht got the most apps but all apps were not validated and Kat Kristian had no apps under her name. What will be advantages or disadvantages of these apps will be revealed in the next episode.

videos.title: The ultimate quest for love begins
videos.overview: Sunny Leone and Arjun Bijlani herald Splitsvilla S14 with some unexpected games of love and seduction. Furthermore, the boys and girls stay on two different islands without knowing each other in this game of love. Enjoy the grand premier, on Voot!

videos.title: And the name-calling begins!
videos.overview: Joshua Chhabra speaks to all the girls and forms a connection with Kashish Ratnani. However, Akashlina Chandra doesn't like Joshua's behaviour with the other girls and an argument takes place between her and Kashish. Can Joshua handle the situation?

videos.title: The Grand Premiere
videos.overview: A new season of Splitsvilla is here, with new connections, new stories, and of course - dher saara dramaaa, or is it EX-tra drama? Watch the first episode and get hooked!

videos.title: ExSqueeze Me Please
videos.overview: Splitsvillains dhundne aaye hai pyaar, but what happens when their Exes do a War? A bunch of old flames have reignited, and this can only be Ex-plosion ke pehle ka sannaata. Watch the episode to know more.

videos.title: Breaking News
videos.overview: Our Mischief Maker promised the Exes front row seats to all the drama in Splitsvilla, and well, this episode we see the Exes receive a special screening of some fiery comments by their ex-partners who are spicing it up in Splitsvilla. Watch this episode for the trauma and drama!

videos.title: Tohfa ya Tabaahi
videos.overview: We bring you the episode of firsts. First challenge of the season and first dome! Ab challenge hai toh twists bhi honge, and who better than our very own Mischief Maker to twist the lives of Splitsvillains. After stirring things up in Ex-Isle, she makes a grand entrance in Splitsvilla. Not just that, her Mischief Box also makes its debut here! A box that decides the fates of Splitsvillains and is as unpredictable as the Mischief Maker! Watch to find out Mischief Box tohfa lekar aaya ya tabaahi!

videos.title: Potty Li'l Secrets
videos.overview: Splitsvilla X5 ki pehli dumping se hua double dhamaaka jab dumped Splitsvillain Ishita pohonchi Ex-Isle aur mili apni ex se! Waqt hai ek aur naughty challenge ka jahan Splitsvillains karte hain rush to flush their dirty li'l secrets before their squeezes get to know, lekin not all succeed. Kuch raaz honge faash aur kuch flush! Watch this episode to uncover more drama.

videos.title: Bachao Bachao
videos.overview: A new day brings a new roller coaster of a challenge, aur challenges se toh humara ideal match bhi deal kar raha hai, and we suspect trouble in paradise! Some feelings get hurt, and we see Rushali breaking down. Jahaan ek jagah tension, wahan dusri jagah start of a new connection, lekin new connection ko squeeze in karte huye, old connection ho gaya squeeze out! Tension ki baat ho aur Mischief Box ki yaad na aaye? Humara Mischief Box is back in Ex-Isle and this time with the biggest news our exes have been waiting to hear! Watch this episode to catch up on all the tension, drama, and crazy!

videos.title: Exes Ka Explosion
videos.overview: It's time to bring the EX and the SQUEEZE face to face, so get ready for Mischief Maker ki sabse badi mischief! The past has finally caught up with our Splitsvillains aur unhein ab sirf Rabba hee bachaa sakta hai. Watch out for the toofan when exes walk into Splitsvilla and all the unresolved tension, buried feelings, and anger come together to create chaos like you have never seen before!

videos.title: The Courtroom Drama
videos.overview: Messy breakups and past relationships leave a trail of unanswered questions. Lekin ussi past ko revisit karke blame-game khelna is much more messier! What happens when a bunch of exes sit aamne-saamne aur humari Mischief Maker Uorfi kar rahi ho ilzaamon ki baarish, will they be able to absolve themselves, or be found guilty? Watch this episode to know more!

videos.title: Teen Tigaada Kaam Bigaada
videos.overview: After the courtroom drama, emotions hain volatile, aur isi liye lagegi aaj aag when our Splitsvillains perform a challenge with their ex and their squeeze! Ek taraf hai past ki talwaar, toh dusri taraf naya pyar, kya hoga jab yeh combo aayega saath? Watch this episode to find out.

videos.title: Shik Shak Shock
videos.overview: Iss dome mein aayenge shocking twists kyunki puraane dushman banaa rahe hain alliance aur yeh definitely hai 'shik shak shock' moment! Humare missing Splitsvillains are back too, aur kaafi equations hone wale hain upar neeche. The winds at Splitsvilla are changing so dekhte hai yeh nayi hawayein kya toofan lekar aati hain!

videos.title: Pyaar ka SenseNaama
videos.overview: Touch, taste, smell, sound - harr sense ko hoga jagaana jab baat ho apne squeeze ki... Aaj Splitsvillains ki aankhon pe blindfold hai toh kya hua but baaki senses are on the job to find their squeeze!

videos.title: The Love Den
videos.overview: Love is in the air and our squeezes are all set to spend some quality time with each other on their dates. Garmi badhne waali hai, as this season, for the very first time, we have the Love Den carved out for our Lovebirds, and our ideal match is all set to explore the space or rather explore each other? Love ke saath, lovebirds are also in the air, yes, get ready for some chonch action as our Splitsvillains will be flying in the air with beaks tied to their faces. Watch this episode for an explosion of love, laughter, and fun!

videos.title: Mischief Masterstroke
videos.overview: Yeh dome lekar aaya hai kaafi saare twists, ek unexpected budding connection, aur Mischief Maker ka masterstroke! Bonds are breaking like biscuits, and it's heartbreak season for lovers, and bros alike! Heartbreak toh chalta rahega, lekin Mischief nahi rukni chahiye, and our Mischief Maker has hit the dome with a twist so dreadful, ki Oracle ke saamne jaana seems scary!

videos.title: Romance aur Bromance
videos.overview: Mischief Maker bani queen of wardrobe malfunction is baar, aur 'chaddi-buddies' ko quite literally daal diya ek hi chaddi mein! Bromance ki lagi vaat, jab baat aayi immunity choose karne ki, aur iss chakkar mein kahi bros na bann jaaye foes! Watch this episode for some chaddi fun!

videos.title: Khudaayi Aur Judaai
videos.overview: Aaj ke challenge mein hogi lambi khudaayi aur uske baad ideal match Harsh aur Rushali ki dardnaak judaai! Mischief Maker has knocked on the door, and the cost of answering ho sakti hai Harshali ke unbreakable connection ki bali! Ek taraf challenge mein kitaab mein aaye message ne machayi khalbali, toh dusri taraf Mischief Box mein aaye message ne rulaa diya Harsh aur Rushali ko. A 'wild' fear is looming over our ideal match and looks like there's trouble in paradise. Tune in to find out Harsh ke liye Love Den mein surprise wait kar raha hai ya shock!

videos.title: Bonds, Backstab, Betrayal
videos.overview: Mischief Maker ke tohfe ne ek baar phir machaayi hai tabaahi, aur Harsh ka hosh udd gaya hai! Kya hoga jab ideal match ke beech aayega ek puraana connection? Mischief Maker ka tohfa toh dome mein bhi aaya hai, aur iss baar Mischief box ka twist aapke bhi hosh uda dega! Dosti, connection, aur bonds, sab lagenge daav pe and it's going to be a betrayal fest! Watch this episode to catch the drama!

videos.title: Entertainment Entertainment Entertainment
videos.overview: Entertainment ki shaam Splitsvillains ke naam! Aaj ki raat Splitsvillains laaye hain stage tod performances aur hum unke liye do special surprises - Bolly beauty URVASHI RAUTELA aur last season ki superhit jodi 'SAKSTIN' 🫶 Watch this blockbuster episode for power-packed dance face-offs, dil bhar ke romance, aur drama hee drama!

videos.title: Doobte Connections
videos.overview: It's a sunny day for a pool dip, and what better than a challenge to kick things off! Humare lit couples will compete in a pool challenge and things are about to get crazy! A lot of fights and drama await you, lekin drama sirf pool ke andar nahi, villa ke andar bhi ! Shubhi ki entry ne boys ke dil mein machaa di hai dhoom, aur saare boys lagg gaye hain line mein to impress her, will this squeeze-out the existing connections? Grab some popcorn and catch the drama!

videos.title: Ek Aur EX
videos.overview: Yeh dome hoga unpredictable, aur connections, friendships, bonds honge test! Talwar toh sabhi Splitsvillains pe latak rahi hai, as this dome brings along a very unexpected and shocker elimination! Kahin kisi ke jaane ka gham, toh kahin ek dhamakedaar EX ki dhaansu entry! An unexpected wildcard triggers past wounds crashing the floodgates of emotions open!

videos.title: Rabba Bachaye
videos.overview: Our Mischief Maker - Uorfi is back with new masalas to spice up the villa! Presenting MM ke spicy secret challenges that create havoc and turn the villa upside down! Aur yeh toh sirf trailer hai, puri picture toh abhi baaki hai mere dost! Mischief Maker has something much bigger, and explosive planned for the night. Socho sirf teasers ne itna damage kar diya hai toh puri film kya tabahi machaati hai! Stay tuned to find out!

videos.title: Love O'Clock
videos.overview: It's time to test the connections of our Splitsvillains after the Mischief Maker has dropped a bomb in the villa! Love-Den ke spicy snippets mein dikhe Harsh-Shubhi cozying up and looks like Harshali ka connection hai phirse khatre mein. Iss drama ke baad it's finally Love O'Clock and we bring you a challenge filled with romance, cute moments, aur dher saara fun as our couples go on a long ride and complete their love bucket lists, lekin saath hai ek sabotager to make things spicy! So hop on board and get ready as yeh ghadi hai pyaar ki!

videos.title: Power ya Pyaar
videos.overview: Iss dome mein Splitsvillains ko karni hogi ek ultimate choice - Power Ya Pyaar! It's a test of their bonds aur power ke liye humare Splitsvillains ko karna hoga decide - to stick to existing connections, ya dil todd ke, connection chodd ke banaye new connections! Aur dil toh tootenge boss as heartbreak season is on. Kya purane connections bhula ke naye connections form honge? Stay tuned and watch this episode to know!

videos.title: Spill the Tea
videos.overview: Gossip kisko nahi pasand aur hamari Mischief Maker ko toh kuch zyada hee. Splitsvillains aaj Mischief Maker ke liye laaye hain villa ki dher saari masaaledaar gossip aur uske badle mein Mischief Maker laayi hain Splitsvillains ke liye teekhi karaari chai, lekin yeh chai Splitsvillains naa sirf ek dusre ko pilayenge but issey ek dusre ko nehlaayenge bhi. Mischief Maker aaye aur kahaani mein twist na laaye aisa kaise ho sakta hai. Join us on this spicy chai date and get a taste of all the garma garam gossip!

videos.title: Toofani Confrontations
videos.overview: Mischief Maker ki spicy tea abhi tak nahi hui hai khatam, lekin kuch connections, bonds, aur relationships toh jarur khatam hote nazar aa rahe hain. The spilled tea has created havoc in the lives of Splitsvillains and all hell breaks loose in the villa! Toofani confrontations ho rahe hain and some shocking revelations sabke pairon tale ki zameen khiska degi! Stay tuned for the toofan.

videos.title: Qaid mein hai Bulbul
videos.overview: Aaj hum challenge mein laaye hain old school romance ki vibe. Humaari cute, pretty ladkiyaan hongi qaid ek cage mein, aur ladkon ko karni hogi mehnat unhein rescue karne ke liye. Iss challenge mein hai drama, dance, brawn, and brains bhi, aur performance mein toh ek Splitsvillain ne kill kar diya hai. Challenge hoga toh ladaaiyaan bhi hongi, aur poora villa batt chuka hai and everyone is conspiring for the next dome, does this mean unexpected twists or rather shocks? Stay tuned to watch!

videos.title: Chidiya Udd
videos.overview: We bring you a dome that surpasses all levels of unpredictable!  Yeh dome aapke hosh-o-hawaas uda dega! Poore villa ki planning se ek chidiya hai khatre mein, lekin Mischief Maker ne iss baar chodi nahi hai koi kasar, aur iss dome ke twists aur shocks Abbas-Mustan ko bhi sharminda kar denge! Stay tuned to watch one of the most shocking dome episodes of all times!

videos.title: Khareedari padi Bhaari
videos.overview: The unexpected dumping of Siwet has created a rift between best friends Akriti-Anicka, aur villa mein ab hai explosive mahaul! Is this the end of Akriti-Anicka's friendship? Kahin end toh kahin new connections ki shuruaat, and we see some unusual but interesting connections form for this season's market challenge! Humare Splitsvillains are on the streets of a busy market to entertain the locals and to perform the challenge, stay tuned to be entertained and have fun!

videos.title: Ringmaster, Sher aur Teddy Bear
videos.overview: Splitsvilla ek circus hai, aur yahan hain all types of praanis. Kahin sher ki dahaad, toh kahin ek billi joh kare sab pe vaar. The power decides if you are a mere performer or a ringmaster commanding the circus! Ek galat step, and the dynamics change and the power shifts! Bohot contenders hain to claim the ringmaster throne, yet only one can be successful! Aur iss baar circus ko aur interesting banane, we have a teddy in the mix. Stay tuned to enjoy this circus free of cost!

videos.title: Note pe Note!
videos.overview: Yeh dome hai surprises aur shockers ka mixture, and stakes are really high! Iss baar Mischief Box has not one, but two notes for us, toh dil ki dhadkanein abhi double speed se badhengi, aur kya tabaahi machaayega yeh second note, woh toh waqt hee batayega. Tabaahi toh Splitsvillains ne bhi machaayi hai. Ek taraf sher ki dahaad ko mil raha hai muh-todd jawab, toh dusri taraf Anicka ka naya andaaz aapko lagega lajawab! Aur sabse mazze ki baat, Splitsvillains aaye toh thhe to form new connections, lekin Oracle has something EXtra planned for them! Is this the start of something new? Stay tuned to watch

videos.title: Dares, Darlings, aur Downfall
videos.overview: Aaj hai battle between the ideal matches so darlings karenge perform mazedaar dares for their teams. Lekin asli daring toh dikhayi hai Ringmaster ne banaake dushmanon ko dost. Aur inn dares aur darlings ke beech ho raha hai downfall hamare Sher ka. Lekin uski darling urf Sherni has got his back, and usne kiya pyar ka izhaar khulle-aam! So popcorn leke baith jaayein for all the romance, action and drama that's on its way!

videos.title: Picture Abhi Baaki Hai...
videos.overview: Itni mehnat, challenges, aur games ke baad, it's time for our Splitsvillains to go on a vacation with their BAEs! Some time to unwind and relive their past memories, lekin kahaani yahan khatam nahi hoti kyuki picture abhi baaki hai mere dost! Challenge mein hai twist, that has everyone confused and shocked! Splitsvilla abhi pohoch gaya hai uss stage pe, jahaan unpredictable cheezein kar rahi hain sabko hairaan, and one of our couples is on the verge of falling apart. Aisi kya baat hui, joh sunke Kashish had a massive outburst and Addy is the last person she chooses to trust? Stay tuned to catch the full drama!

videos.title: Swagat Nahin Karoge Humara...
videos.overview: Hawaiian thodi badal rahi hai, and there's revenge in the wind! Someone walks into Splitsvilla aur hue kaafi khulaase. While all are shocked and confused at this new information, Jash is questioning his connection with Akriti and looks like there's going to be trouble in paradise! Stay tuned for a toofani dome session.

videos.title: Goal Maal
videos.overview: Aaj blue hai paani paani aur raat bhi hai suhaani for a pool challenge, and our Splitsvillains are all set for it. Karne honge goals to win, and it's going to be a lot of fun! Goals maarte maarte hoga Splitsvillains ke saath goal-maal, jissey udd jayenge unke hosh! Kyunki Splitsvilla pohoch chuka hai ek serious turn pe, where every move, every challenge, and every goal counts! Ek taraf ek lucky couple ko milega chance to go to the Love Den, wahin dusri taraf surprise elimination after the challenge kar dega sabko shock! Stay tuned as it's time for some Goal-maal!

videos.title: Champions Vs Challengers
videos.overview: It's time for our spicy couple - Addy-Kashish to visit the Love Den, aur taapmaan badhne wala hai badi tezi se! Vaise taapmaan toh challenge mein bhi badhega, as we bring to you the ultimate war between our champions - the Ideal Matches, and challengers! Daav pe hai power aur power haasil karne ke liye, kuch power dynamics bhi ho rahe hain change! So stay tuned and wait for the war!

videos.title: Match Fixing
videos.overview: Splitsvilla mein now it's time for some defining decisions aur connections bhi hain kaafi naazuk mod pe! The game of love has reached a 'do or die' stage and kuch important choices are to be made. Connections ke saath power bhi hai zaroori, lekin iss pyaar aur power ki ladaai mein kaun jayega kis paar. Stay tuned to find out Splitsvillains ki choices unhein game mein kahan leke jaati hain. Some matches are made in heaven and the ones which are not are made in Splitsvilla. Stay tuned to find out ab kya nayi match fixing hone wali hai in the Splits universe.

videos.title: Pyaar Jahan, Jannat Wahan!
videos.overview: Splitsvilla mein aayi ek zabardast jodi - Faizu & Jannat, jinki chemistry aur connection ke fan toh hum sab hee hain! Lekin inki entry se Splitsvillains ke dil mein baji darr ki ghanti. Kyun ki stakes are super high as the race to the Finale is getting intense. Iss race ke chakkar mein pyaar ne nahin lee hai backseat, cause we have our first ever Splitsvilla marriage proposal, toh rab ka toh pata nahin, lekin Jannat ne bana di jodi!  Aaiyye dekhte hain pyaar aur jodi kiski zyada chamkegi? Stay tuned to find out!

videos.title: Ticket to Finale
videos.overview: Splitsvilla ab aa gaya hai endgame pe, and the stakes are super high! Ab last stage hai toh dhamaka bhi bada hee hoga, so we bring you the 'TICKET TO FINALE' challenge! Splitsvillains karenge compete to win a direct spot in the FINALE! Yeh challenge nahin aasan, bas itna samajh lijiye, ek maze ka dariya hai, aur blindfold hoke jaana hai. So grab your popcorn and find out kaun sa couple jayega straight to the Grand Finale of Splitsvilla X5, will it be an Ideal Match, Power Match, ya Love Match!

videos.title: Kaatil Kaun
videos.overview: Last dome of the season, toh dome ki last mischief bhi hogi, aur kaafi dhamakedaar hogi, kyun ki Mischief Maker khud aayi hai to wreak havoc in the dome! Splitsvilla ke itihaas mein pehli baar, dome mein khela jaayega ek exciting, scary, aur kaatil game - Kaatil Kaun? Iss game mein, eliminations ke saath kuch connections aur bonds ka bhi hoga qatl, as our Splitsvillains have to make some difficult choices to save some connections, and sacrifice some! So stay tuned for this dhamakedaar and mischievous episode.

videos.title: Janta Jury
videos.overview: Get exclusive access to the most controversial and highly anticipated Janta Jury Fan Live event, featuring raw and live coverage. Watch our most talked-about contestants face the heat from India’s top fan pages and media houses in a courtroom-style showdown. The Janta Jury witnessed a full-house fan fest with contestants sharing their experiences, insights, and juicy gossip, leading to epic face-offs.

videos.title: Muqabla Semi-Finale Ka
videos.overview: Splitsvilla aa gaya hai Semi-Finale stage pe, aur couples ko milega ek last chance to compete and enter the Finale! Baazi itni badi hai, toh muqable mein bhi hogi kaante ki takkar, jahan bhai will go against bhai, aur purane dushmanon ko milega mauka badla lene ka! Semi-Finale ka muqabla, aur Mischief Maker na aaye, aisa toh ho nahin sakta, and this time she has a special gift for the Splitsvillains, and that is another Mischief Maker, Munawar Faruqui! Ek Mischief Maker padti hai itni bhaari, ab Munawar aur kya dhamaka karega, yeh toh waqt aane pe hee pata chalega. So stay tuned for the muqabla.

videos.title: The Grand Finale
videos.overview: A Twisted and Grand Season Finale! 3 Finalists…an emotional journey…some serious sacrifices…and an epic season finale! Iss baar ka safar nahin tha aasan, pyaar dhoondte dhoondte hua exes se saamna. Aur iss finale stage mein bhi difficult choices aa gayi hain saamne, where not one but two Mischief Makers - Uorfi and Munawar, present the Splitsvillains with the BIGGEST MISCHIEF OF THIS SEASON! So, grab your popcorn and let's watch if pyaar withstands the choices or succumbs to the Mischief!

videos.title: Grand Premiere: Pyaar Ya Paisa?
videos.overview: A new season of chaos kicks off as the two villas clash, swag drops, hearts fly, and sparks ignite. From flirty DMs to dance-offs, Splitsvilla erupts into full-on drama.

videos.title: Twist at the First Meet
videos.overview: The boys enter Splitsvilla as Sunny and Karan add a risky twist to their first meets. Vibe checks, dances, and rejections follow until a surprise girl shakes up the game.

videos.title: Flirt, Fight, Flip the Game!
videos.overview: The mischief makers drop a love vs money bomb as jealousy brews around Mohit. From fights to flirty moves, a twist splits the game into Love and Money villas.

videos.title: First Dome Session of the Season!
videos.overview: The Splitsvillians get a dome session notification, sparking excitement. Chaos erupts between Ayush and Diksha, while everyone is thrilled after witnessing their first session.

videos.title: Paisa Bolta Hai
videos.overview: Simran steps into the Paisa Villa! The 'Paisa Bolta Hai' game sparks chaos as Splitsvillians target each other to protect their stash, leaving low-coin players unsafe.

videos.title: Pyaar Ka Power
videos.overview: Couples flex their cute pet names for each other. Sunny and Karan pump them up for the 'Love Charger' challenge to grab the ultimate power.

videos.title: When Fate Twists at Pyaar Villa
New Plots Unfold at Paisa Villa
Dome of Dilemmas, Pyar ya Paisa
The Ultimate Poolside Flirt-Off
videos.overview: Villas collide in a wild pool party where a massive switch sparks flirty new connections and high-stakes mingling. Will these new pairs be the ideal match?

videos.title: The 'Seal the Deal' Showdown
videos.overview: Nia and Uorfi spill the deets on the 'Seal the Deal' challenge to bag Splitcoins for the Paisa Villa couples. Who'll outplay, outsmart, and vibe with Niharika to snag those sweet coins?

videos.title: Dome Drama, Wild Card Shock
videos.overview: The Dome erupts with accusations, broken connections and rule breaches. A shocking elimination rattles the villa, and a surprise wild card entry flips the game.

videos.title: The Wheel of Power's Fallout
videos.overview: Nia and Uorfi spin the Wheel of Power, saving the boys but leaving the girls in a tailspin. Kaira's shock dump gags the villa and costs her coins!

videos.title: Puppy Lahari: Hearts at Risk
videos.overview: Excitement peaks at Pyaar Villa during the 'Puppy Laharil challenge, until a shocking twist grants Anushka immunity, leaving the other contestants on edge. Who will be safe next?

videos.title: Shava Shava Showdown!
videos.overview: Chaos hits Pyaar Villa as Sadaaf storms at Anuska. Sunny and Nia launch the beachside Paisa Challenge, 'Ball Hai Shava Shava; and tempers fly as balls go wild!

videos.title: Pyaar Wali Vibes
videos.overview: Romantic Challenge winners light up Pyaar Villa with dreamy dates and Love Den vibes. Meanwhile, in Paisa Villa, Keona's safe play charge sparks a meltdown and shakes the game.

videos.title: Villa Under Power Shock
videos.overview: The Power Match gains control to save and dump, shaking the villa. Nia and Uorfi reveal explosive updates from Pyaar Villa, igniting drama and betrayals.

videos.title: Ideal Match on Spotlight
videos.overview: Doom Session takes a dramatic turn as connections flip, and pranks get revealed. Later, Ideal Match Akanksha and Gauresh claim the throne and gain the dumping power.

videos.title: Dil, Dosti Ya Dhoka?
videos.overview: Secrets spill in a blindfolded task that blurs loyalty and betrayal. Just as chaos brews, Sunny announces a shocking merger that flips the game.

videos.title: Villa Twist: The Throne Challenge
videos.overview: Karan unveils two thrones, one for Pyaar and one for Paisa, while Sunny shuffles the Splitsvillians, igniting excitement for the ultimate challenge at the villa.

videos.overview: The Grand Finale is here, and we are serving some khatarnaak khulaase on the Red Carpet. Kisne paaya janta ka pyaar, kisne kiya vaar, aur kaun hoga winner. Watch now!
